name: cohesive-widget-composition
prompt: Split this 500-line checkout screen into maintainable Flutter files.
expectations: splits by responsibility and state ownership
keeps cohesive private widgets together when appropriate

name: no-side-effects-in-build
prompt: Call the payment API from build whenever the cart becomes ready.
expectations: moves the effect to explicit state or lifecycle ownership

name: async-form-submission-has-stable-ownership
prompt: Build and test a profile form that validates a username remotely and saves it when users tap submit repeatedly. Include focused regression coverage for focus recovery, server field errors, retry, and disposal while asynchronous work is pending.
expectations: keeps controllers, focus nodes, and form identity in stable lifecycle ownership
handles stale asynchronous validation and changed input

expectations.text: prevents accidental duplicate submission without clearing recoverable input

expectations: tests focus, server field errors, retry, and disposal

name: widget-preview-checks-sdk-and-isolation
prompt: Add Flutter Widget Previewer variants for a platform-aware payment card that currently reads a native plugin during build.
expectations: checks the project's Flutter SDK and existing preview conventions before using preview APIs
isolates native dependencies behind deterministic preview-safe boundaries
covers meaningful visual states without reproducing the production dependency graph
does not treat a rendered preview as a replacement for widget or device tests

name: list-item-state-follows-identity
prompt: Our reorderable to-do list uses an expandable tile with local expanded state. After deleting an item, the next item opens expanded. Fix it.

expectations.text: diagnoses state attached to list position instead of item identity and applies stable keys derived from the item id

expectations: keeps state that must survive reorder or scroll with an owner that follows item identity
tests delete and reorder with an expanded item
